key: ...y, are you okay?!
en: ...y, are you okay?!
ja: ……ィ、大丈夫?!

key: Wake up!
en: Wake up!
ja: 起きて!

key: AME: Thank goodness, you're okay!
en: AME: Thank goodness, you're okay!
ja: アメ: よかった、無事だったのね!

key: AME: That train exploded right as we\npulled into the station.
en: AME: That train exploded right as we\npulled into the station.
ja: アメ: あの電車、駅に到着した瞬間に\n爆発したのよ。

key: I'm--
en: I'm--
ja: わたしは――

key: I'm just glad I could get us out of there in time, but everyone else--
en: I'm just glad I could get us out of there in time, but everyone else--
ja: 間に合ってわたしたちを助け出せたのは良かったけど、他のみんなは――

key: Well... there's no use thinking about that now.
en: Well... there's no use thinking about that now.
ja: まあ……今それを考えても仕方ないわ。

key: Why did this have to happen...?
en: Why did this have to happen...?
ja: どうして、こんなことに……?

key: Who would even--
en: Who would even--
ja: いったい誰が――

key: ???: Hihi!
en: ???: Hihi!

key: AME: ...Julia.
en: AME: ...Julia.
ja: アメ: ……ジュリア。

key: AME: Julia, what did you do?
en: AME: Julia, what did you do?
ja: アメ: ジュリア、何をしたの?

key: JULIA: Whaaaaat? I didn't do anything!
en: JULIA: Whaaaaat? I didn't do anything!
ja: ジュリア: なにそれー? アタシ、何もしてないってば!

key: I was at the Gymmie-Gym and then suddenly BOOOOM, so I came running!
en: I was at the Gymmie-Gym and then suddenly BOOOOM, so I came running!
ja: ジムジムにいたら、いきなりドッカーンって鳴って、それで走ってきたの!

key: Cuz, you know, if things are exploding, I gotta be there to see it!!!
en: Cuz, you know, if things are exploding, I gotta be there to see it!!!
ja: だってさ、何か爆発するなら、絶対現場に居合わせなきゃでしょ!!!

key: AME: Uh huh.
en: AME: Uh huh.
ja: アメ: そう。

key: Based on the timing, this must have been\na deliberate attack.
en: Based on the timing, this must have been\na deliberate attack.
ja: このタイミングだと、これは\n意図的な攻撃だったに違いないわ。

key: Somebody rigged the train\nto destroy Grandview Station.
en: Somebody rigged the train\nto destroy Grandview Station.
ja: 誰かが電車に細工して、\nグランドビュー駅を破壊しようとしたのね。

key: Or maybe it was...
en: Or maybe it was...
ja: それとも、もしかして……

key: JULIA: If they did want to destroy it, they could've tried a little harder!
en: JULIA: If they did want to destroy it, they could've tried a little harder!
ja: ジュリア: 本気で壊すつもりなら、もっと頑張ればよかったのに!

key: I mean, the structure's still standing!
en: I mean, the structure's still standing!
ja: だって、建物まだ立ってるじゃん!

key: What's up with that!
en: What's up with that!
ja: どういうことよ!

key: This is like a 6/10 job at best!
en: This is like a 6/10 job at best!
ja: これじゃせいぜい10点満点中6点ってとこよ!

key: AME: ...
en: AME: ...
ja: アメ: ……

key: Anyway,
en: Anyway,
ja: とにかく、

key: Whoever was behind it could still be monitoring from nearby.
en: Whoever was behind it could still be monitoring from nearby.
ja: 犯人は、まだ近くから様子を見てるかもしれない。

key: I'll have the perimeter locked down. We may yet catch them.
en: I'll have the perimeter locked down. We may yet catch them.
ja: 周辺を封鎖させるわ。まだ捕まえられるかもしれない。

key: AME: I'm going ahead, \PN.
en: AME: I'm going ahead, \PN.
ja: アメ: わたしは先に行くわね、\PN。

key: There's another Trainer that was meant to register with you at the same time, so find her and then come see me.
en: There's another Trainer that was meant to register with you at the same time, so find her and then come see me.
ja: あなたと同じタイミングで登録する予定だった、もう一人のトレーナーがいるの。彼女を見つけたら、わたしのところに来てちょうだい。

key: I'll be in the Grand Hall, just down this road. You can't miss it.
en: I'll be in the Grand Hall, just down this road. You can't miss it.
ja: 大ホールにいるから。この道をまっすぐ行けば分かるわ。

key: And don't you worry about all of this.
en: And don't you worry about all of this.
ja: それと、これについては心配しなくていいから。

key: I'll have it completely taken care of.
en: I'll have it completely taken care of.
ja: きっちり片づけておくわ。

key: JULIA: So you're \PN?
en: JULIA: So you're \PN?
ja: ジュリア: あんたが\PN?

key: I'm Julia, captain of cheer and pep, and all things bubbly and bright!
en: I'm Julia, captain of cheer and pep, and all things bubbly and bright!
ja: アタシはジュリア、元気と応援と、キラキラ明るいもの全部の隊長よ!

key: Oh, pop quiz!\nAre you going to take on the Reborn League?
en: Oh, pop quiz!\nAre you going to take on the Reborn League?
ja: あ、抜き打ちクイズ!\nリボーンリーグに挑戦するつもり?

key: Correct!
en: Correct!
ja: 正解!

key: Then I'll be seeing you very soon, because I'm also the Electric Gym Leader!
en: Then I'll be seeing you very soon, because I'm also the Electric Gym Leader!
ja: それじゃあ、すぐに会うことになるね、だってアタシ、でんきタイプのジムリーダーでもあるから!

key: Whaaaaaaat? That's no fun! You simply must!
en: Whaaaaaaat? That's no fun! You simply must!
ja: えぇー? つまんない! 絶対やらなきゃだめだよ!

key: I insist you give it a try!
en: I insist you give it a try!
ja: とにかく挑戦してみてよね!

key: After all, I'm the Electric Gym Leader!
en: After all, I'm the Electric Gym Leader!
ja: だってアタシ、でんきタイプのジムリーダーなんだから!

key: Wait, but didn't Ame just say she registered you?
en: Wait, but didn't Ame just say she registered you?
ja: って、あれ、アメがさっき、あんたのこと登録したって言ってなかった?

key: I see, you're doing one of those things where you pull the Wooloo over my eyes!
en: I see, you're doing one of those things where you pull the Wooloo over my eyes!
ja: なるほどね、それってウールー使ってアタシの目を欺こうとしてるやつでしょ!

key: Veryyyy tricky, \PN.
en: Veryyyy tricky, \PN.
ja: すっごーく、ずる賢いね、\PN。

key: I'm onto you!
en: I'm onto you!
ja: アタシ、お見通しだから!

key: I'll be looking forward to your challenge, so go on! Get down to the Grand Hall already!
en: I'll be looking forward to your challenge, so go on! Get down to the Grand Hall already!
ja: あんたの挑戦、楽しみにしてるから! ほら、さっさと大ホールに行きなよ!

key: JULIA: It's just a quick walk to the east!
en: JULIA: It's just a quick walk to the east!
ja: ジュリア: 東にちょっと歩くだけだよ!

key: Go on already!
en: Go on already!
ja: ほら、さっさと行った行った!

key: The exterior has held up, but the interior is completely trashed...
en: The exterior has held up, but the interior is completely trashed...
ja: 外観は持ちこたえてるけど、中は完全にめちゃくちゃだ……

key: We should be able to send off some outgoing cars still, but the incoming line is going to take a long time to repair.
en: We should be able to send off some outgoing cars still, but the incoming line is going to take a long time to repair.
ja: 出発便はまだ何とか動かせそうだけど、到着路線の修理には時間がかかりそうだ。

key: The device was remotely triggered.
en: The device was remotely triggered.
ja: 装置は遠隔で起爆された。

key: According to the radio signal, the detonation device had to have been in a fifty foot radius.
en: According to the radio signal, the detonation device had to have been in a fifty foot radius.
ja: 電波の記録からすると、起爆装置は半径15メートル以内にあったはずだ。

key: Then the culprit is most definitely around here somewhere...
en: Then the culprit is most definitely around here somewhere...
ja: だとすれば、犯人は間違いなくこの辺りにいるはずだが……

key: ???: Another victim of the crash?
en: ???: Another victim of the crash?
ja: ???: また事故の被害者か?

key: Quit your snivelling and go to the back of the line like the rest of them.
en: Quit your snivelling and go to the back of the line like the rest of them.
ja: めそめそするのはやめて、他の者と同じように列の後ろに並べ。

key: Those who cut won't get treated,
en: Those who cut won't get treated,
ja: 割り込む者は治療しない、

key: But all who wait will get what help can be given.
en: But all who wait will get what help can be given.
ja: だが待つ者には、できる限りの助けを与えよう。

key: Whatever pain you feel, know it was not deserved.
en: Whatever pain you feel, know it was not deserved.
ja: どんな痛みであれ、それはお前が受けるべきものではなかったと知れ。

key: ???: Can you stop shaking?
en: ???: Can you stop shaking?
ja: ???: 震えを止められるか?

key: PATIENT: Y-yeah, sorry.
en: PATIENT: Y-yeah, sorry.
ja: 患者: う、うん、ごめん。

key: It just hurts.
en: It just hurts.
ja: ただ、痛くて。

key: And I feel kind of just a little bit panicky after being in, like, an entire trainwreck...
en: And I feel kind of just a little bit panicky after being in, like, an entire trainwreck...
ja: それに、電車事故に丸ごと巻き込まれたあとだから、ちょっとパニックになってて……

key: ???: It is an understandable anxiety.
en: ???: It is an understandable anxiety.
ja: ???: 理解できる不安だ。

key: Hold still, and I will give you two tonics.
en: Hold still, and I will give you two tonics.
ja: 動くな、2種類の薬を与える。

key: One will calm the pain.
en: One will calm the pain.
ja: ひとつは痛みを鎮める。

key: One will calm your nerves.
en: One will calm your nerves.
ja: もうひとつは、神経を落ち着かせる。

key: PATIENT: Is that really safe?
en: PATIENT: Is that really safe?
ja: 患者: それ、本当に安全なの?

key: ???: It is safe.
en: ???: It is safe.

key: I know because I created them both.
en: I know because I created them both.
ja: 私自身が両方とも調合したのだから、分かっている。

key: Neither is suitable to long term use, but if the need were to come up, I would not hesitate to use them on either myself or my daughter.
en: Neither is suitable to long term use, but if the need were to come up, I would not hesitate to use them on either myself or my daughter.
ja: どちらも長期の使用には向かないが、必要とあれば、私自身や娘に使うことも、私はためらわない。

key: The city, too, has decreed that they are beneficial enough to be worth asking me to come here and use them.
en: The city, too, has decreed that they are beneficial enough to be worth asking me to come here and use them.
ja: 市もまた、ここに来て使用するよう私に求めるだけの有益性があると、正式に認めている。

key: Does this belay your concerns?
en: Does this belay your concerns?
ja: これで、お前の懸念は解消されたか?

key: PATIENT: Y-yeah...
en: PATIENT: Y-yeah...
ja: 患者: う、うん……

key: Sorry, you just kind of give off a scary vibe, you know?
en: Sorry, you just kind of give off a scary vibe, you know?
ja: ごめん、なんかその、怖い雰囲気があるからさ。

key: ???: This is not the first time I've been told that.
en: ???: This is not the first time I've been told that.
ja: ???: そう言われるのは、今回が初めてではない。

key: It will not be the last.
en: It will not be the last.
ja: そして、最後でもないだろう。

key: I lost my capacity for cheerful expression long ago.
en: I lost my capacity for cheerful expression long ago.
ja: 私はずっと昔に、朗らかな表情を作る力を失った。

key: It was taken from me.
en: It was taken from me.
ja: それは、私から奪われたものだ。

key: Those of you who can still smile should enjoy doing so,
en: Those of you who can still smile should enjoy doing so,
ja: まだ微笑むことができる者は、それを大切にするといい、

key: Just so long as it is not in delusion.
en: Just so long as it is not in delusion.
ja: それが妄想でない限りは。

key: PATIENT: Um.
en: PATIENT: Um.
ja: 患者: あの。

key: ???: It seems my stock of painkiller is running low.
en: ???: It seems my stock of painkiller is running low.
ja: ???: 鎮痛薬の在庫が、少なくなってきたようだ。

key: No matter; this last one will be enough for the remaining patients.
en: No matter; this last one will be enough for the remaining patients.
ja: 構わない、この最後の一本で、残りの患者には十分足りるだろう。

key: HOTSHOT: Wait, that's the last one?
en: HOTSHOT: Wait, that's the last one?
ja: ホットショット: 待てよ、それが最後の一本かよ?

key: Shit, no way I'm waiting for it to get used up then. Move!
en: Shit, no way I'm waiting for it to get used up then.  Move!
ja: くそ、そんなの使われるまで待ってらんねえ。どけ!

key: PATIENT: O-ow, hey!
en: PATIENT: O-ow, hey!
ja: 患者: い、痛っ、ちょっと!

key: HOTSHOT: I'll be taking this, pops. Thanks!
en: HOTSHOT: I'll be taking this, pops. Thanks!
ja: ホットショット: これ、もらっとくぜ、じいさん。悪いな!

key: ???: Are you hurt worse?
en: ???: Are you hurt worse?
ja: ???: さらに怪我をしたか?

key: PATIENT: He shoved me out of the way pretty roughly, but it shouldn't be too much-- ow!
en: PATIENT: He shoved me out of the way pretty roughly, but it shouldn't be too much-- ow!
ja: 患者: かなり乱暴に突き飛ばされたけど、大したことは――痛っ!

key: ???: Come. I can still treat you.
en: ???: Come. I can still treat you.
ja: ???: 来い。まだ治療はできる。

key: ???: Trainer, I cannot leave this patient.
en: ???: Trainer, I cannot leave this patient.
ja: ???: トレーナー、私はこの患者から離れるわけにはいかない。

key: If you have any inkling of goodwill in your body, I ask you to find that crook and recover my medical supplies.
en: If you have any inkling of goodwill in your body, I ask you to find that crook and recover my medical supplies.
ja: お前にわずかでも善意があるなら、あの盗人を見つけ出し、私の医療品を取り戻してきてほしい。

key: Time is a key factor. Act fast or it will be too late.
en: Time is a key factor. Act fast or it will be too late.
ja: 時間が肝要だ。急がねば手遅れになる。

key: He fled north. That would be as good a place to start as any.
en: He fled north. That would be as good a place to start as any.
ja: 奴は北へ逃げた。手がかりとしては、そこから始めるのが良いだろう。

key: ???: Our culprit forfeited the stolen goods after all.
en: ???: Our culprit forfeited the stolen goods after all.
ja: ???: あの犯人は、結局盗んだ品を手放したか。

key: I understand that was your work.
en: I understand that was your work.
ja: お前の働きだと聞いている。

key: It was acceptably done.
en: It was acceptably done.
ja: 十分によくやった。

key: You have both my gratitude, and that of our last remaining patient.
en: You have both my gratitude, and that of our last remaining patient.
ja: 私からの感謝と、最後に残った患者からの感謝、両方を受け取るがいい。

key: Along with it, an introduction.
en: Along with it, an introduction.
ja: それに加えて、自己紹介をしよう。

key: You may call me Corey.
en: You may call me Corey.
ja: コーリーと呼んでくれて構わない。

key: COREY: It is regrettable-- the circumstances that required us to gather here to treat the injured.
en: COREY: It is regrettable-- the circumstances that required us to gather here to treat the injured.
ja: コーリー: 遺憾なことだ――我々がここに集まり、負傷者を治療せねばならなかったこの状況は。

key: To reduce the influx, while allowing departure...
en: To reduce the influx, while allowing departure...
ja: 流入を減らしつつ、退去は許す……

key: To disrupt a necessary supply chain...
en: To disrupt a necessary supply chain...
ja: 必要な補給路を断つ……

key: To remove a lynchpin in the fabric of the city...
en: To remove a lynchpin in the fabric of the city...
ja: この街を支える要を取り除く……

key: How many excuses will be used to justify a tragedy which claimed the lives of so many, I wonder?
en: How many excuses will be used to justify a tragedy which claimed the lives of so many, I wonder?
ja: これほど多くの命を奪った悲劇を正当化するために、いったいいくつの言い訳が用いられるのだろうか。

key: Incidentally, you were also on that train, were you not?
en: Incidentally, you were also on that train, were you not?
ja: ちなみに、お前もあの電車に乗っていたのではないか?

key: And yet here you are, standing on the other side of the service line.
en: And yet here you are, standing on the other side of the service line.
ja: それでいて、こうして治療する側に立っている。

key: Do continue to carry yourself with respect.
en: Do continue to carry yourself with respect.
ja: これからも、自らを敬意をもって律するように。

key: There is much that will require decisive action and strong presence of will in the coming days.
en: There is much that will require decisive action and strong presence of will in the coming days.
ja: これから先、決断力と強い意志が求められる場面が、数多くあるだろう。

key: You may take these in aid of your cause.
en: You may take these in aid of your cause.
ja: これを、お前の目的の助けとして持っていくといい。

key: COREY: Until next we meet.
en: COREY: Until next we meet.
ja: コーリー: また会う日まで。

key: YOUTH: O-ow! Ugh, that stings!
en: YOUTH: O-ow! Ugh, that stings!
ja: 少年: い、痛っ! うう、しみる!

key: ???: Only temporarily.
en: ???: Only temporarily.
ja: ???: 一時的なものだ。

key: The wound must be disinfected before it can be dressed.
en: The wound must be disinfected before it can be dressed.
ja: 包帯を巻く前に、傷は消毒しておかねばならない。

key: It may sting, but it will burn far worse should you ignore the problem, and by neglect, allow it to fester.
en: It may sting, but it will burn far worse should you ignore the problem, and by neglect, allow it to fester.
ja: しみるだろうが、この問題を無視して放置し、かのうさせてしまえば、はるかにひどく痛むことになる。

key: If that's what you want, I can stop.
en: If that's what you want, I can stop.
ja: それが望みなら、やめてもいいが。

key: YOUTH: N-no, sir. Please...
en: YOUTH: N-no, sir. Please...
ja: 少年: い、いや、お願いします……

key: ???: The transaction of short term pain for long term healing is a difficult one for the young to understand.
en: ???: The transaction of short term pain for long term healing is a difficult one for the young to understand.
ja: ???: 短期的な痛みを長期的な治癒と引き換えにするという取引は、若者には理解しがたいものだ。

key: Hold still.
en: Hold still.
ja: 動くな。

key: You do not have the experience to know why the world has hurt you.
en: You do not have the experience to know why the world has hurt you.
ja: お前には、なぜ世界がお前を傷つけるのかを知るだけの経験が、まだない。

key: You must trust the adults in your life.
en: You must trust the adults in your life.
ja: お前は、自分の周りの大人たちを信じねばならない。

key: All too often they are incapable of adequately earning that trust.
en: All too often they are incapable of adequately earning that trust.
ja: もっとも、その大人たちが、その信頼にふさわしくあれることは、あまりに少ないのだが。

key: This is the tragedy between every generation.
en: This is the tragedy between every generation.
ja: これは、あらゆる世代の間に横たわる悲劇だ。

key: There. The difficult part is done.
en: There. The difficult part is done.
ja: さて。難しい部分は終わった。

key: Now I'll apply a numbing agent to relieve the pain while you wait.
en: Now I'll apply a numbing agent to relieve the pain while you wait.
ja: これから、待っている間の痛みを和らげるため、麻酔薬を塗ろう。

key: That should be better already, yes?
en: That should be better already, yes?
ja: もう、いくらか楽になったのではないか?

key: YOUTH: Yes, sir...
en: YOUTH: Yes, sir...
ja: 少年: はい……

key: ???: Worth waiting for?
en: ???: Worth waiting for?
ja: ???: 待つ価値はあったか?

key: YOUTH: Yes, sir.
en: YOUTH: Yes, sir.
ja: 少年: はい。

key: ???: Good.
en: ???: Good.
ja: ???: よろしい。

key: Now wait a mite longer as I apply the bandages and you'll be on your way.
en: Now wait a mite longer as I apply the bandages and you'll be on your way.
ja: 包帯を巻く間、もう少しだけ待て。それで終わりだ。

key: YOUTH: Thank you, sir.
en: YOUTH: Thank you, sir.
ja: 少年: ありがとうございます。

key: Please, I swear my shoulder has been killing me ever since the impact...
en: Please, I swear my shoulder has been killing me ever since the impact...
ja: お願い、衝撃を受けてからずっと、肩が死ぬほど痛いの……

key: Ugh, what is my luck today?!
en: Ugh, what is my luck today?!
ja: ああ、今日はなんてついてないんだ?!

key: If you can find that painkiller fast, you'd be my second hero!
en: If you can find that painkiller fast, you'd be my second hero!
ja: 早くあの鎮痛薬を見つけてくれたら、あなたは二人目の英雄だよ!

key: Apparently the police have set up this makeshift station to help treat the wounds of the train crash's survivors.
en: Apparently the police have set up this makeshift station to help treat the wounds of the train crash's survivors.
ja: 警察が、電車事故の生存者を治療するために、この仮設の救護所を設けたらしい。

key: But that guy sure doesn't seem to be a normal officer, does he?
en: But that guy sure doesn't seem to be a normal officer, does he?
ja: でも、あの人、どう見ても普通の警官には見えないよな?

key: ...Got a problem?
en: ...Got a problem?
ja: ……何か文句でも?

key: I've a right to be here.
en: I've a right to be here.
ja: 私にも、ここにいる権利がある。

key: I'm a victim of the crash as much as any of you.
en: I'm a victim of the crash as much as any of you.
ja: 私だって、他の誰とも変わらない事故の被害者だ。

key: Look, I'm clearly limping. See?
en: Look, I'm clearly limping. See?
ja: ほら、明らかに足を引きずってるでしょ? 見て

key: Please, please hurry up!
en: Please, please hurry up!
